undated_mentions: Started school at the local Catholic school in Devonport
Won scholarship and attended Auckland Grammar School
Elected a scholar of Trinity College, Cambridge
Won a one-year research studentship at the British School at Athens
Joined the Communist Party while at Cambridge
Claimed to have resigned from the Communist Party before the war
Evacuated to Crete and then Cairo
Attended officer training school and was commissioned second lieutenant
Joined the Long Range Desert Group
Transferred back to 2nd New Zealand Division as divisional intelligence officer; promoted captain
Got to know Boris Pasternak during Moscow posting
Helped get Doctor Zhivago manuscript to Pasternak's sisters in Oxford
Informed by Alister McIntosh that his career in External Affairs was finished
Posting to Paris as First Secretary arranged and allowed to proceed after Prime Minister Holland's reprimand
Questioned about the Kroger case after the 1961 arrests; denied knowledge
Observed meeting a Soviet agent shortly before his death (per MI5 file)
